visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in an indoor setting with a glossy red floor. A young boy with short black hair, wearing a white t-shirt with a beige lower half and grey shorts, stands centrally. Behind him is a large vertical sign with Japanese text and an illustration of a fish. A woman in a white shirt and black shorts stands to the left, partially cut off by the frame. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a commercial interior. (2) The scene shifts to a group sitting on a dark wood bench around a shallow rectangular pool. The pool bottom is bright blue with painted yellow and red flowers. Small grey fish are visible in the clear water. A man in a white t-shirt and glasses sits on the right, and a young girl in a white t-shirt sits on the left. The boy is in the middle, looking hesitantly at the water. (3) A close-up displays the man reacting with a wide-open mouth, suggesting a ticklish sensation. The shot returns to the group. The girl and man have their legs submerged up to their shins. Clusters of tiny fish swarm around their feet. The boy remains seated with his feet out of the water, observing the fish and his companions' reactions. (4) The boy finally dips his feet into the pool. The man supports him by the shoulders. The girl laughs heartily, throwing her head back. The setting includes a traditional Japanese screen in the background with a mascot illustration. The camera is mostly static with slight handheld adjustments, maintaining a medium shot of the family. (5) The three individuals are now fully engaged in the experience. Hundreds of small fish are concentrated around their submerged feet. The boy appears more relaxed, looking down at his feet. The father leans in to speak to him. The overall color tone is warm and natural, emphasizing the family-friendly atmosphere.
